mainEntity.name: Can you assist with minor repairs or surface imperfections before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Frasheski Construction provides comprehensive surface preparation, which includes addressing minor repairs and imperfections before painting. This often involves patching holes, filling cracks, sanding rough areas, and repairing drywall damage. Proper surface preparation is crucial for achieving a smooth, flawless finish and is a standard part of our interior painting coordination service. We ensure that all surfaces are in optimal condition, whether for a small touch-up or a full renovation in areas like Albany or El Cerrito.
